e1a5139b690dd1e0.description:
Associate Product Manager

1-3 Years Of Experience

Location: Versova, Mumbai or HSR, Bengaluru

Full-time, in-office role.

Build product features that solve real user problems and improve the live

entertainment experience.

Company: thumpN

thumpN is an AI-native discovery and ticketing platform that unifies discovery, ticketing, and on-ground tools for fans, artists, venues, and promoters.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

thumpN is where the show begins.

At thumpN, we build products that make discovering and experiencing live entertainment effortless. From the moment a fan opens the app to the second they walk through the venue gates, every interaction is a product decision.

As we grow into new cities and categories, we need someone who can bridge customer insight and business need—translating both into product improvements that ship. This role is for someone who is curious, analytical, and execution-focused. Someone who enjoys making decisions with data, working across teams, and building things users actually love.

What You’ll Actually Do

Real responsibilities, not a wish list

Product Execution

• Own smaller features and improvements end to end, from problem definition to launch. 
• Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from senior PMs. 
• Manage sprint-level backlog items and work with engineering to keep delivery on track. 

User Research and Analysis

• Talk to fans, organizers, and venue teams to understand their problems firsthand. 
• Pull and analyse data on feature usage, funnels, and drop-offs, and turn it into recommendations. 
• Track competitors and new formats in ticketing and live entertainment. 

Collaboration and Delivery

• Work with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to ship features. 
• Coordinate testing, QA, and releases, including high-traffic launches and ticket drops. 
• Keep stakeholders informed with clear, regular product updates. 

What You Bring

Curiosity, rigour, and the drive to ship

Required

• 1-3 years of experience in product, business analysis, consulting, analytics, engineering, or a similar role. Strong freshers with relevant projects or internships are welcome to apply. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and comfort working with data. 
• Clear written communication. You can explain a problem and a proposed solution in a page. 
• Evidence that you have built, launched, or improved something on your own initiative (a product, side project, college initiative, or process). 
• Familiarity with tools like Jira, Linear, Notion, or similar. 

Preferred

• Exposure to consumer internet, marketplace, or mobile products. 
• Hands-on with Mixpanel, GA4, Amplitude, or SQL. 
• Basic understanding of UX principles and user research. 
• A genuine love for live entertainment: concerts, comedy, theatre, festivals, sports, or nightlife. 

NON-NEGOTIABLES

How we know this is the right fit

• You start with the problem, not the solution. A feature that launches without solving anything is a miss. 
• You back your opinions with evidence. Gut feel has a role, but it earns its place alongside data and user insight. 
• You learn fast and ask good questions. You seek feedback, act on it, and get better every sprint. 
• You follow through. When something is yours, you see it to launch and check whether it worked. 
• You thrive when priorities shift. Live entertainment does not follow a predictable roadmap. You adapt without losing momentum. 

Skills: analytics,data,launches,product management
